```yaml
name: Publish Java Bulk CDK Base Package

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'temurin'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Check if base version already exists in Maven repository
        id: version_check
        run: |
          BASE_VERSION=$(grep "version=" airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/version.properties | cut -d'=' -f2)
          echo "Base version to check: $BASE_VERSION"
          
          # Check if this version already exists in Maven Central or our repository
          # Using mvn dependency:get to verify version doesn't exist
          if mvn dependency:get -Dartifact=io.airbyte:bulk-cdk-core-base:$BASE_VERSION -DremoteRepositories=central > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Version $BASE_VERSION already exists in Maven repository"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "Version $BASE_VERSION does not exist in Maven repository"
          fi

      - name: Build base package
        if: steps.version_check.outcome == 'success'
        run: |
          cd airbyte-cdk/bulk
          ./gradlew :core:base:build

      - name: Publish base package
        if: steps.version_check.outcome == 'success' && success()
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
        run: |
          cd airbyte-cdk/bulk
          ./gradlew :core:base:publish
```
